harnessFlags.issue: ScrollTrigger count compared against a fresh page that is not re-mounted and not scrolled; once:true triggers (home-up.js:154, site.js:99/123/131) remove themselves on enter, so the count tracks scroll position, not the resize.
harnessFlags.fix: remountNoSnap(fresh) + scrollWheelTo(fresh, share) before triggerCount, then re-run T8.

harnessFlags.issue: The test plan says T3 fails today at 1440x900 (open wheel across the words column, E9). It passed because shownBoxes() only counts words at opacity >= .05, and T6 shows the words column is empty from t=0.78 to 6.72, which covers the open point. With no obstacle, freeRect is the whole stage, so the wheel cannot cross the words and the fill passes. The desktop defect shows as T6 (L), not T3.
harnessFlags.fix: Measure the words column's layout box (rectOf on .hx-copy / .rfw-h) whatever its opacity, or assert that the words are up at .36-.45. Also add the plan's `rest` and `one` checkpoints and the hint-vs-legend and wheel-vs-hx[1] checks (review N1/N4), which the spec does not implement yet.

harnessFlags.issue: The plan expects T9 red today (an h2 held 22 px low over a 12 px gap, E13). The probe waits until headings stop moving before it measures, so it only sees the settled end of the rise. T1 at 390x844 does catch the same overlap (h2#cta-h over its p on 6 pages, plus #who-h, #grow-h, #deep-h, #people-h, #cmp-h, #words-h, #ask-h).
harnessFlags.fix: Sample during the rise (several frames right after each scroll step, with no settle wait), or check the held offset before the reveal fires.

harnessFlags.issue: The closed #mobile-menu drawer is counted as 12 or more hidden links, plus a fixed element. WP1.1's print CSS (build-plan lines 139-144) only makes elements static. It never removes the drawer, so these cells cannot go green unless the fix sets #mobile-menu{display:none} in print or the probe excludes a closed menu.
harnessFlags.fix: Decide which side handles it before WP1.1 and write that into the plan.

harnessFlags.issue: An empty `ol.fixed` (the React toast viewport, no text) counts as sticky/fixed content. The header in these React pages comes from the site frame, not public/site, and WP1.1's CSS targets public/site.
harnessFlags.fix: Ignore empty or zero-size fixed elements in the print sweep, and make sure WP1.1's print rule reaches the site-frame header.

harnessFlags.issue: The reference ratio is the first sample with |zO| > 1e-3, which is near zero lift (-11.841 / -120.599 at 1440x900), so all 460-odd lines are measured against noise. The verdict stands on the clean signals: the ratios drift inside the open plateau (-2.188 to -2.294 to -4.035), and the open pairs differ by size.
harnessFlags.fix: Use the open (max |zO|) sample as the reference, or ignore samples with |zO| < 5% of the maximum.

harnessFlags.issue: The empty-window sweep found nothing at these sizes. Each cell is red only because the wheel has no 'Start free trial' link at share 1, which is true on master by construction. The 'filled' predicate takes any fully visible h1-h3 and any button anywhere in the window, without pairing them, so it is lenient. E11 (an empty white stage) reproduces only at 1288x593.
harnessFlags.fix: Require the button to sit in the same section as the heading, and re-check E11 at 1440x900 and 390x844 by eye from the video.

harnessFlags.issue: Each failure repeats what a fresh load shows (the T3 fit and the T5 legend). No resize-specific divergence is shown yet, so 'resize differs from a fresh load' is not proven by this run. The plan marks it unknown.
harnessFlags.fix: Once HF1 is fixed, re-read T8. If it is green apart from the T3/T5 predicates, drop the resize claim from bug W's symptom.

harnessFlags.issue: These cells are off centre by 0.063-0.068 against a 0.06 limit. They are product-red, but only just over the limit, so they could flip from run to run before any fix.
harnessFlags.fix: None needed for the baseline. Watch for flips.
